methods.name: ask_user_question
methods.description: Ask the user one to four structured questions and return the selected or custom answers as text.

question.description: The complete question to ask the user. It should be clear, specific, and end with a question mark.

header.description: A short chip label for the question, limited to 16 characters.

label.description: A concise option label, limited to 60 characters. Do not use the reserved labels Other, Type something., or Next.

description.description: What the option means or what will happen if selected.

preview.description: Optional markdown preview for concrete artifacts such as layouts, code, diagrams, or configuration. Use only for single-select questions.

options.description: Two to four distinct choices. A custom-answer row is appended automatically.

multiSelect.description: Set to true when the user may select multiple options.

questions.description: One to four questions to present in a single questionnaire.
